scope: Verify the FreeCAD-compatible -o route chooses its documented default DXF target from imported DXF source revisions and from locally authored DWG source profiles, honors ASCII/Binary output selection, and exposes the pre-output target projection in debug mode.

control.runtimeAuthoredInput: The minimal SOURCE DXF is written in a temporary directory with only $ACADVER varied. AC1015/1018/1021/1024/1027/1032 DWG sources are written by the local test writer at runtime; no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
assertions: All nine source revision headers select the expected FreeCAD -o DXF default, including the AC1012 compatibility mapping to AC1014.
Each DXF source default is emitted as ASCII and Binary DXF with the exact $ACADVER value.
Binary DXF is checked with R12 one-byte group-code framing for AC1009 and two-byte framing for later revisions.
Locally authored AC1015, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032 DWGs succeed through FreeCAD -o at the source revision in ASCII and Binary; binary outputs read back at the same revision.

AC1018 output is refused in ASCII/Binary at default AC1018 and explicit AC1024 because the completed read contains two opaque callbacks and strict output qualification is 0/2; a pre-existing destination sentinel and the source bytes remain unchanged.

Debug mode reports a bounded pre-output projection of source format/revision, target revision, implicit-versus-explicit target selection, output encoding and input-appropriate read-completeness mode. Generated AC1012 DXF input verifies the AC1014 default and not-applicable DWG completeness field; generated AC1006 DXF input verifies fail-closed reporting when no default exists; generated AC1021 DWG success and AC1018 default/explicit refusal controls verify the projection before output preflight.

limits: This receipt covers all supported source-DXF header defaults plus the six DWG writer versions. The AC1018 generated profile remains unqualified and refused; other routes and native CAD acceptance remain separate.

Strict output was refused because the reader observed two object parse failures and an incomplete frame disposition; no output was published. The sample remained in temporary storage and is not a committed fixture. This observes default selection only, not AC1014 output/readback or support.
AC1012 DWG-source default output/readback remains uncovered. The AC1014 external diagnostic probe does not qualify output, whole-file semantics or native acceptance.
This is CLI contract evidence, not a DWG/DXF semantic support claim.
